system.description: When you choose this tradition at 2nd Level, you gain the ability to learn ninjutsu with the Lightning Release Keyword. If you already have access to this nature release, you learn 2 Lightning Release Ninjutsu that you qualify for, one of which can be C-Rank or lower. You can also learn and create Ninjutsu with the Lightning Release Keyword in half the required time.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
